property_summary: After any deposit via Put with a past timestamp, the funds stay locked until the unlock time, so an immediate Collect cannot withdraw them and the contract's balance stays at least MinSum; the mutant accepts the past timestamp verbatim and lets Collect drain the deposit right away.
change_summary: Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past timestamp can set an already-unlocked time.
